spl_product_data_elements: Antibiotic neomycin sulfate neomycin sulfate neomycin mineral oil petrolatum
active_ingredient: Active ingredient (in each gram) Neomycin Sulfate (3.5 mg Neomycin)
indications_and_usage: Use first aid to help prevent infection in minor scrapes, cuts, and burns
warnings: Warnings For external use only Do not use in eyes over large areas of the body or on puncture wounds, animal bites or serious burns for more than 1 week unless directed by a doctor if you are allergic to any of the ingredients Stop use and ask a doctor if a rash or allergic reaction develops condition worsens or persists Keep out of reach of children If ingested, contact a Poison Control Center right away.
do_not_use: Do not use in eyes over large areas of the body or on puncture wounds, animal bites or serious burns for more than 1 week unless directed by a doctor if you are allergic to any of the ingredients
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if a rash or allergic reaction develops condition worsens or persists
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children If ingested, contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions clean affected area apply a small amount 1 to 3 times daily may cover with a sterile bandage
